units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 35:3">Is. XXXV, 3</cite>) <he>שהן נראות כאילו כּוֹשְׁלוֹת</he> knees which have the appearance of stumbling (threaten to stumble).
<cite ref="Isaiah 35:3">Ib.</cite> <he>שכְּשַׁלְתֶּם וכ׳</he> for you have really stumbled (sinned) through your evil deeds.
Num. R. s. 16 כְּשַׁלְתֶּם you have stumbled (were discouraged; Tanḥ. Shlaḥ 2 נתרשלתם); a. e.—כּוֹשֵׁל (law) weak, under legal disadvantages (in adapt. of Is. l. c. a.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 9:2">Keth. IX, 2</cite> <he>ינתנו לַכּ׳ שבהן</he> let it be given him who is under the greatest disadvantage of all (the claimants being the deceased man’s widow, his creditor and his heirs); expl.

<cite ref="Ketubot 84a:16">ib. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>לכ׳ שבראיה</he> to him who is under disadvantage for evidence (whose document is of the latest date); [oth. opin.] <he>לכתובת אשה</he> to the widow, v. <cite ref="H00813"><he>חִינָּא</he></cite>; Y. ib. IX, 33ᵃ top <he>לכ׳ שבראיותיו וכ׳</he> to him who is the weakest as to evidence, e.g. he who loaned without witnesses as against him who has witnesses.
<cite ref="Ketubot 84a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>לכ׳ בגופו</he> to him who is in feeble health (and poor).

senses.gloss: to be struck, meet with an accident. Mekh. B’shall. s. 2 לא נ׳ אחד וכ׳ not one of them (the Egyptians) met with an accident (was detained) on the road. Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᶜ bot. נ׳ באצבעו got a sore finger; ib. XVI, 15ᶜ top; Lam. R. to IV, 20; a. e.
to stumble, fall; to be led to sin. Pesik. Shub., p. 165ᵃ והיו … נִכְשָׁלִין בו and people stumbled over it (the rock); Yalk. Hos. 533.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 533">Ib.</cite> <he>אדם נ׳ בעכירה</he> if man becomes a victim of sin.

<cite ref="Gittin 43a">Gitt. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>אין אדם … אא״כ נ׳ בהן</he> one never gets at the true sense of the words of the Law, except after mistakes; <cite ref="Chagigah 14a">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 120a">Sabb. 120ᵃ</cite>.—
Ber. 28ᵇ ולא אֶכָּשֵׁל בדבר הלכה and that I may not err against a hălakhah; ולא יִכָּשְׁלוּ וכ׳ nor may my colleagues &c.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII</cite> <he>בשביל … איני נִכְשֶׁלֶת</he> because I am a queen, I shall not come to grief; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cause to stumble, to be an obstruction; to weaken; to cause sin. Y. Shebi. III, end, 34ᵈ a breach in the fence מַכְשֶׁלֶת את הרבים annoying the public (an obstruction to traffic).
units: R. Hash. I, 6 נמצאת מַכְשִׁילָן לע״ל thou wilt make them sin in future cases (by their refraining from going to court); Yoma 77ᵇ שלא תהא מַכְשִׁילָן וכ׳ that thou mayest not cause them to sin (by staying away from college); Kidd. 33ᵃ; Ḥull. 54ᵇ מְכַשְּׁלָן (Pi.).—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11b:5">Ab. Zar. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>פיהם הִכְשִׁילָן לרשעים</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ה׳ פיהם</he>) their own (ominous) words brought these wicked men to fall; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18">Num. R. s. 18</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 16b">B. Kam. 16ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 9b:11">B. Bath. 9ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>מכשלים</he>, <cite ref="Jeremiah 18:23">Jer. XVIII, 23</cite>) <he>הַכְשִׁילֵם וכ׳</he> make them stumble by sending them unworthy subjects of charity.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC</cite> <he>לעצמי הייתי מַכְשִׁיל</he> I should have injured myself.

senses.gloss: to weaken, break the force of. Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ bot. מְכַשְּׁלוֹ בגבעות (Gen. R. s. 24 מרשלו), v. חָשַׁל.
